title: Dominican National Police cyber unit arrests three people over separate electronic scams
date_note: Hoy's page, published 24 November, gives no earlier day for the arrests.
org: Policía Nacional (Dirección de Área de Policía Cibernética)
geo_basis: Prosecutors' offices in Santo Domingo are named; the pin is the capital
summary: Hoy and Ciudad Oriental report that the Dominican National Police's cyber police unit arrested three people separately over alleged electronic scams, including a fake shipment request from a supposed cousin, a phone sale offered on Instagram and fake work-from-home offers. The arrests were made under Law 53-07 on high-technology crimes, and the three remain under the Ministerio Público.
plain: Dominican cyber police arrested three people in separate online scam cases. They remain in prosecutors' custody.
exec: Dominican police report three arrests under the high-technology crimes law.

validation.note: Hoy and Ciudad Oriental, two publishers, each report the arrests by the police cyber unit.
